East Plains has allocated supplies to establish a local joint epidemic-prevention fund: if a ship is delayed and the North Shore medicine ship has not arrived, surplus local treatment stations will use local grain and scrap to brew epidemic-prevention medicine as a stopgap. The medicine allocation sent to Old Town and expenses under the original agreement remain unchanged.

North Shore and East Plains have signed a public mutual-aid pact: each North Shore ship carries 24000 medicine, and East Plains returns 12000 tools and sets aside {变量1} medicine from the arriving shipment for transfer to Old Town. Though both regions are willing to share public responsibilities, this does not mean the center will collect household assets, nor does it mean a nation has been established.
